bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to health; appropriating money for the Greater Twin Cities United Way.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; GREATER TWIN CITIES UNITED WAY.

$2,800,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $2,800,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for a grant to Greater Twin Cities United Way to expand services for call follow-up, operational support, outreach efforts, and increased support for callers.
additions: APPROPRIATION; GREATER TWIN CITIES UNITED WAY.

$2,800,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $2,800,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for a grant to Greater Twin Cities United Way to expand services for call follow-up, operational support, outreach efforts, and increased support for callers.
